CustomField.description: Legal company line for service emails, language neutral: name, address, registration, VAT, managing directors (DE). Built from this Administration; never hardcode.
CustomField.formula: Subscription25__Billing_Name__c & ' · ' & Subscription25__Billing_Street__c & ', ' & Subscription25__Billing_Postal_Code__c & ' ' & Subscription25__Billing_City__c & ', ' & Subscription25__Billing_Country__c & IF(ISBLANK(Subscription25__Chamber_Of_Commerce_Number__c), '', ' · Reg. no. ' & Subscription25__Chamber_Of_Commerce_Number__c) & IF(ISBLANK(Subscription25__VAT_Number__c), '', ' · VAT ' & Subscription25__VAT_Number__c) & IF(ISBLANK(Managing_directors__c), '', ' · Managing director(s): ' & Managing_directors__c)
CustomField.label: Legal Company Block
